set: C: surface and detail, native crops of the ten keys

issues.where: the arrow crop, whole left panel
issues.what: the arrow is a flat white shape with a black outline, no thickness, no bevel and no gloss; even inside a well-rendered clear ball it reads as a 2D paper insert, not a solid arrow
issues.fix: give the arrow real depth: extrude the shape, bevel the edges, add a glossy clear coat and a side wall visible at this angle so it reads as a solid object inside the ball

issues.what: same flat arrow: it fills the bubble as a single flat white plane with a printed outline, no thickness catching the light
issues.fix: model the arrow as a solid with edge highlights and a small shadow inside the ball that separates from it as it lifts

issues.where: the arrow crop, bottom middle, and the ring crop
issues.what: the arrow lies on the panel like a sticker, flat white with an outline, and in the ring crop it is visibly warped where it crosses the glass ridge, with no thickness and almost no shadow
issues.fix: raise the arrow into a 3D piece with a bevel and a contact shadow; let refraction, not a bent decal, explain any distortion under glass

issues.where: the long table crop, lower right of the tabletop
issues.what: a yellow checkered cloth piece floats in mid-air below the table edge with no attachment, and the cups and small rings on the tabletop sit at slightly odd scale
issues.fix: remove the floating scrap or hang it over the edge with contact; scale the tableware to match real tableware

issues.where: a steel ball crop, upper left
issues.what: the balls read as dark smoky marbles with a painted highlight, not chrome steel; there is almost no environment in their reflection
issues.fix: mirror the surroundings in the ball surface so it reads as polished steel

issues.what: the whole crop is a blur of streaks; the plunger and its gold knob have no readable edge at native size
issues.fix: reduce the depth of field at this distance so the plunger rod, spring and knob keep a readable edge

issues.what: the panel is one heavy motion blur with no sharp element, which reads as a smear rather than a surface at native size
issues.fix: keep at least the lamppost or lamp housing sharp so the blur reads as deliberate depth of field

issues.where: a flipper crop, right of the orange flipper
issues.what: small white crumbs and a hanging paper scrap float beside the flipper with no support, reading as stray debris on the render, not as themed parts
issues.fix: remove the debris or seat the scraps on the floor with contact shadows

issues.where: the tower crop, small sign on the building
issues.what: the apartment nameplate print is a soft grey smudge; it fails the smallest-text test at native size
issues.fix: sharpen the plate letterforms or drop the micro print for a plain plate
